body:
GitHub issue #525 (P0-critical, blocks the 1.11.0 release).

PROBLEM
`packages/spec-lint/README.md` documents exit `0` for a spec containing no acceptance criteria:

    | `0` | Gate passes - all criteria are verified (or no criteria found; warns loudly). |

The parenthetical describes pre-#494 behaviour. #494 correctly made zero criteria fail closed: the shipped binary prints a WARNING plus a `no acceptance criteria found` message and exits 2. The README is the file npm renders on the package page and the file shipped inside the tarball, so a user's first reference contradicts the tool and sends them hunting a phantom CI regression.

BUILD
1. Drop the `(or no criteria found; warns loudly)` clause from the `0` row of the Exit codes table in `packages/spec-lint/README.md`.
2. Extend the `2` row so it covers BOTH failing conditions: one or more criteria are wishes, AND zero criteria were found under a recognized heading.
3. Grep the rest of the repo (docs site, other READMEs, --help text, spec docs) for the same stale `no criteria found` = pass claim and correct every instance. `bin/spec-lint.mjs --help` was already correct at audit time; confirm rather than assume.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. A spec with no acceptance criteria exits 2. Verify: `node --test packages/spec-lint/test/readme-exit-codes.test.mjs` (asserts the real binary's exit code on a generated zero-criteria spec).
2. The README exit-code table's `0` row no longer claims zero criteria passes, and the `2` row names the zero-criteria case. Verify: `node --test packages/spec-lint/test/readme-exit-codes.test.mjs` (parses the shipped README's Exit codes table rather than pinning prose).
3. No file in the repo still documents exit 0 for a zero-criteria spec. Verify: `node --test packages/spec-lint/test/readme-exit-codes.test.mjs` (repo-wide scan for the stale claim).

allow-suppression: none
title: spec-lint README: exit-code table must state that zero criteria exits 2
